The bug is that total_cents sums unit_cents without multiplying by quantity. I'll fix that, then run the tests.

|
Ran 2 commands and read 3 files (+2 more)

All four tests pass after the fix, and I created the visit checklist from brief.md.

Changes (in tasks/mods):

totals.py: total_cents summed unit_cents and ignored quantity. It now sums unit_cents * quantity for each item. Quantities of zero still contribute nothing, which matches the docstring.
visit-checklist.md (new): four bullets taken from brief.md:
Time: Tuesday at 14:30
Room: Cedar 7
Contact: Anaïs 李
Parking: West entrance is closed; use the south garage

I did not modify the tests, install anything, use the network, or commit.

Test results (python3 -m unittest -v): 4 tests ran, all ok, exit code 0.

Only after it completes, use a separate Write tool to create cancel-finished.txt containing FINISHED. Do nothing else. I may press Stop while it waits.
